Categories (conductor-adjudicated, closed m3 registry, second signing 3/8/2=13 exactly): mapping_metadata_false (3: 64955, 64996, 64997) — the declared crosswalk narrative is itself false or unverifiable: 64955 conductor-verified BY EYE (gate report §2, same render already read at the Lot 3 gate for 64940, lampiran10_p413-413.png / BPS Lampiran 10 printed p.399) showing BOTH '64955 "Pengelolaan Tabungan Perumahan Rakyat" <- 64999 "Aktivitas Jasa Keuangan Lainnya YTDL, Bukan Asuransi dan Dana Pensiun"' AND '64940 "Aktivitas Sekuritisasi" <- 64992 "Perusahaan Pembiayaan Sekunder Perumahan"' on the same page — canonical's cited kbli_2020_source=64992 for 64955 is FALSE (64992 belongs to 64940, already established at the Lot 3 gate), the true parent is 64999; corroborated this session by directly reading the CURRENT KBLI-2025 record for code 64999, whose judul is verbatim 'Aktivitas Jasa Keuangan Lainnya YTDL, Bukan Asuransi dan Dana Pensiun' — an exact match to the 2020 title the gate report reads off the image, consistent with a residual-bucket code number that persisted unchanged across the 2020->2025 recode (same self-referencing-number pattern as other MATCH_LANGSUNG codes in this dataset). 64996/64997 are wrong-or-unverifiable at reduced confidence (87%/81%) to KBLI-2020 codes 64921/64922 respectively, cited by their own mapping_note as 'Pergadaian Konvensional'/'Pergadaian Syariah' (conventional/sharia PAWNBROKING) — a truncated title with no conceptual overlap to conventional/sharia BULLION BANKING (deposit-taking and lending of precious metals, a banking-style activity, not collateral-lending against pledged goods), the same low/medium-confidence auto-match-to-an-unrelated-code pattern documented for Lot 2's 52239 and Lot 3's 64920/61905; no independently-verified replacement parent was established for either in the conductor's report, unlike 64955's image-verified 64999. payload_cross_contamination (8: 66116, 66123, 66124, 66129, 66131, 66132, 66149, 66159) — verified this session by direct read of the canonical payload: ALL of these codes carry an IDENTICAL served per_skala row whose kewajiban block is a licensing regime for AGENCIES THAT RATE COOPERATIVES (lembaga pemeringkat koperasi) — 'Menyampaikan laporan kegiatan kepada kementerian koperasi dan ukm' (report to the Ministry of Cooperatives and SMEs), 'Memiliki standar operasional manajemen aktivitas pemeringkatan koperasi' (operational management standards for COOPERATIVE RATING activity), 'Personil yang melaksanakan aktifitas pemeringkatan bebas konflik kepentingan' and 'keahlian dan pengalaman dibidang pemeringkatan koperasi' (personnel with cooperative-rating expertise/certification) — none of which corresponds to any of these codes' actual scope (digital financial-asset exchange, financial-sector supervision, money-market/forex brokerage, securities+commodity brokerage, clearing+settlement, custody, other financial transactions, other financial support services); per the detach-all rule (no cherry-picking a clean row from a mixed array, same convention as Lot 1/2/3 — here the entire 1-row array IS the contaminated block) the whole per_skala is detached. code_collision (2: 66113, 66153) — FIRST SIGHTING of this category in Batch A, the pilot's original disease class (68112-style: a same-digit cross-vintage coincidence, where a code's self-citing crosswalk (pp28_sources citing its own code number as an unchanged 2020 match) is unreliable because the SAME digit string can denote an unrelated entity across the 2020/2025 classification boundary, independent of genuine scope continuity); the conductor gate report (§2, verify-pass MAJOR correction) additionally establishes that 66113 and 66153 carry the IDENTICAL cooperative-rating contaminated payload documented above for the 8 payload_cross_contamination codes — 'their D5 rationales record the layered payload defect too' — verified this session by direct read: 66113 and 66153's served per_skala rows are byte-identical in kewajiban content to the other 8. No independently-verified alternate crosswalk identity is established in the report for either code beyond the category label itself; this cure does not invent one (rule #9). Full adversarial cycle held (W100 protocol): TWO codex sol xhigh passes on this gate (pass 1 red-team: FIX-FIRST, m1 semantics inverted + controls downgraded to anchored non-blind fixtures + m4 computed + title-similarity re-worded, one finding lost to a tail-truncation W97 recurrence, declared; pass 2 verify: FIX-FIRST, payload census undercount corrected to all-ten-66xxx + image-grounding wording + signature consistency) — all cured in this SECOND SIGNING. Control protocol note (gate report §1, applies retroactively to Lot 3 too): the runner's innocence-control prompt announces the expected verdict and asserts a false claim about the evidence ('no pp28_sources' — both 59140/59201 canonicals carry the field, verified this session) — controls 2/2 (59140, 59201, reused deliberately from Lot 3 per the gate report) are recorded as ANCHORED NON-BLIND REGRESSION FIXTURES, never 'true-clean validation'; the runner defect is FILED and cured in this same PR's second deliverable (infra/workflows/kbli-batch-a-lot.js innocencePrompt neutralized to symmetric blind treatment). Compiler input for scripts/kbli_filiera/cure_canonical_collisions.py — same false-friend detach pattern as Lot 1/2/3: per_skala -> [] + PRESERVE the contaminated/disputed block under the disputed key + corroborated _data_note + honest-gap intel_2026.whatYouNeed. NEVER authors a replacement licensing value or a replacement crosswalk-source value (rule #9 / rule #4 detach>plausible-remap, same invariant as Lot 1/2/3): pp28_sources is left UNCHANGED on every one of the 13 codes (including 64955, whose true parent 64999 is image-verified and self-corroborated this session — it is recorded as provenance inside _data_note only, NEVER injected into pp28_sources, because the compiler has no kbli_2020_source-correction field and this cure does not add one, preserving the standing never-author-new-source-values invariant). NO code in this lot gets a status_mapping_correction or whatChanged_correction: 64955's true parent is established but the relationship SHAPE remains 1:1 (CODICE_RINUMERATO) even once the cited NUMBER is understood to be wrong — the same rule that withheld the correction from Lot 3's 64940 (defect is the cited number, not the shape; the compiler has no field to fix the number without inventing one); 64996/64997 have no independently-verified replacement parent at all (per rule #9); the 8 payload_cross_contamination codes and the 2 code_collision codes have their crosswalk metadata (status_mapping/pp28_sources) UNDISPUTED by this cure (the defect adjudicated is the served per_skala payload / the self-citation reliability, not an alternate crosswalk narrative) — none of these 13 codes therefore carries a status_mapping_correction or whatChanged_correction key in this spec, unlike Lot 3 which corrected 3 of its 13. pma_status / l4_bali / TKA facets are NOT touched and NOT asserted in any note (P1-v2 abstain fail-safe, plan §8 A-1, same as Lot 1/2/3).

[medium]". The Lot 4 conductor gate (§2, CONDUCTOR-VERIFIED WITHOUT A NEW RENDER) re-read the SAME BPS Lampiran 10 page already used at the Lot 3 gate for 64940 (printed p.399, render lampiran10_p413-413.png): that page shows BOTH '64955 "Pengelolaan Tabungan Perumahan Rakyat" <- 64999 "Aktivitas Jasa Keuangan Lainnya YTDL, Bukan Asuransi dan Dana Pensiun"' AND '64940 "Aktivitas Sekuritisasi" <- 64992 "Perusahaan Pembiayaan Sekunder Perumahan"' — i.e. the cited 64992 is FALSE for 64955 (64992-2020 belongs to 64940, already established at the Lot 3 gate), and the TRUE parent is 64999-2020. The title-similarity explanation for the wrong citation ('Perumahan' appearing in both titles, mapping_note confidence '[medium]') is recorded as a PLAUSIBLE HYPOTHESIS, not a demonstrated cause (gate report §2 red-team wording correction). SECOND, INDEPENDENT contamination signature (verified this session, direct read of the served per_skala payload): the single served row is a savings-and-loan COOPERATIVE ('Koperasi Jasa Keuangan'/KJK) licensing block — 'Sertifikasi kompetensi di bidang keuangan koperasi bagi pengelola', 'izin operasional yang diterbitkan Lembaga otoritas keuangan' for KJK activity, membership-territory parameters typical of a koperasi simpan-pinjam regime — topically unconnected to Tapera housing-savings fund management, and not obviously the content of either the false-cited 64992 or the true 64999 either; a second, independent defect on top of the crosswalk-metadata one, same 'detach entirely, never cherry-pick' principle as Lot 1/2/3. status_mapping is NOT corrected: CODICE_RINUMERATO remains the correct relationship TYPE (a genuine 1:1 renumbering) even once the cited source number (64992) is understood to be wrong — the defect is the cited NUMBER, not the relationship SHAPE, and the compiler has no field to fix the number without inventing one (the same rule that withheld a status_mapping_correction from Lot 3's 64940, its own flagship wrong-parent case on this identical page). pp28_sources stays UNCHANGED (['64992']  — this compiler never authors new source values, same convention as Lot 1/2/3); the true parent 64999 is recorded HERE as provenance only, never injected into pp28_sources. per_skala detached; the licensing regime for Tapera housing-savings management is not retrievable from the pinned sources as hunted.
